_comment: Decision rights for internal bookkeeping. Nothing here interrupts Danny — the
worst case is a Xero draft. The gate on things that leave the business lives in
egress.json, and no number in this file can get past it.
auto_authorise_max_sgd — mapped vendor + high confidence at or below this posts
straight to AUTHORISED. Above it, the bill is still posted, just as a DRAFT,
so the coding gets a glance before it becomes the working figure. Raise this
as the Run Log shows clean weeks; it only controls how much lands in the
draft pile, never whether something reaches you.
auto_map_max_sgd — an unmapped vendor this small isn't worth even a draft; the
agent posts on its suggested account, writes the mapping, and logs it.
ask_to_learn_mappings — off by default. On, an unmapped vendor above the
trivial line becomes a one-tap prompt whose answer writes the mapping. Only
worth it if you'd rather clear mappings from your phone than in Xero.
draft_max_sgd is no longer read: size can't make an internal posting less
reversible. It's kept in the file so old deploys don't KeyError.
